description: This file defines an interface `MessageCommandAdapterProvider` in Java, which declares methods for providing adapters related to message commands and their responses. It acts as a provider interface within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter for messaging.

classes.name: MessageCommandAdapterProvider
classes.description: An interface that provides methods for obtaining adapters for message commands and message command responses within the protocol adapter framework.

methods.name: getMessageCommandAdapter
methods.description: Returns an adapter capable of handling `MessageCommand` objects.

methods.name: getMessageCommandResponseAdapter
methods.description: Returns an adapter capable of handling `MessageCommandResponse` objects.
